description_sq:
Ofrohet vile 3-kateshe per shitje ne Kombinat.
Jepet vile 3-kateshe per shitje ne Kombinat. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nje zone shume e qete dhe te ofron facilitetet per nje jetese sa me komode te tilla si : shkolla,kopshte,farmaci etj . Vila organizohet ne tre kate, kati i pare organizohet ne nje sallon se bashku me kuzhinen, kati i dyte organizohet ne 3 dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet ndersa kati i trete organizohet ne nje sallon dhe nje tualet. Gjithashtu vila disponon dy vende parkimi.
Per cdo informacion me kontaktoni!
description_en: A 3-storey villa is offered for sale in Kombinat. 3-storey villa for sale in Kombinat. The area in which it is located is a very quiet area and offers facilities for a comfortable life such as: school, kindergarten, pharmacy, etc. The villa is organized in three floors, the first floor is organized in a living room together with the kitchen, the second floor is organized in 3 bedrooms and a toilet, while the third floor is organized in a living room and a toilet. The villa also has two parking spaces. For any information contact me!
